meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: Claude 会按 JSON Canvas 规范创建和修改 .canvas 文件,支持文本、文件、链接、分组等节点,以及节点间的连线,并校验 ID 唯一性与引用关系。
howto.when: 当用户提到 .canvas 文件、Obsidian 的 Canvas 文件,或要求做思维导图、流程图等可视化画布时触发。

say.text: 把这张思维导图做成 .canvas 文件
say.note: 生成含文本节点和连线的画布文件。

say.text: 新建一个 .canvas,放入待办、进行中、完成三个分组
say.note: 生成带分组节点的看板式画布。

say.text: 给流程图加上“是/否”分支和箭头

howto.what_en: Claude can create and edit valid .canvas files per the JSON Canvas spec, producing text, file, link, and group nodes plus connecting edges, and validating unique IDs and existing references.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions .canvas files, Canvas files in Obsidian, or asks for visual canvases such as mind maps or flowcharts.

say_en.text: Turn this mind map into a .canvas file.
say_en.note: Creates a canvas with text nodes and connections.

say_en.text: Create a .canvas with groups: To Do, In Progress, Done.
say_en.note: Produces a board-style canvas with group nodes.

say_en.text: Add yes/no branches and arrows to this flowchart.
